probing_cost_estimate.cost_proxy_basis: Use the measured full official training update mean as a per-sample resource proxy scaled by actual probing/training batch sizes; no prober forward/train batch is timed in this allocation.
probing_cost_estimate.limitation: Not a measured prober cost or guaranteed upper bound. The full training update includes backbone backward work, while probing uses different forwards and may add visualization/plotting. Retain extra walltime margin and do not call this a measured evaluation estimate.
